ModuleTitle.helper: Used by OpenContent and DNN module settings. This is not displayed to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a page anchor for direct links to this section. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

SectionTitle.helper: Optional. Main heading displayed above the cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

SectionDescription.helper: Optional. Briefly introduce this group of cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: Practical, dependable services designed around your goals.

BentoCards.helper: Add as many cards as needed. Only the first four are displayed. Card 1 displays its image, and Card 4 displays up to four value propositions.

CardTitle.helper: Optional. Add a short, clear card heading. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.

CardDescription.helper: Optional. Explain this item in one or two concise sentences. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
CardDescription.placeholder: Build a clear plan that connects your website to your business goals.

CardIcon.helper: Optional. Find icons at FontAwesome. Example: fas fa-building

CardIconColor.helper: Choose a Bootstrap or portal.css text color. The icon background uses a transparent version of the same color. Check the selected color against the card background for accessible contrast.

Image.helper: Required. Uploads go to Content/. Use a landscape image at least 1200 by 675 pixels. Only Card 1 displays its image in this layout.

ImageAltText.helper: Optional but IMPORTANT for meaningful images. Describe what the image communicates for people using assistive technology. Leave blank only when the image is decorative.
ImageAltText.placeholder: Two people reviewing a website plan together

LearnMoreText.helper: Optional. Text displayed for the card link. When a URL is present and this is blank, Learn more is used. If the card title is blank, use descriptive link text for accessibility.

LearnMoreUrl.helper: Optional. Select a local page or enter a complete http or https URL. When valid, the entire card becomes clickable.

ValuePropositions.helper: Optional. Add short supporting points. Only Card 4 displays these values, and only its first four entries are rendered.

SectionFooter.helper: Optional. Add a short note below the cards. HTML is allowed and will render as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Choose a service to learn more.
